parameters.description:
Relay a message through your own Chanify sender by posting a native Chanify payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`chanify-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `chanify` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Chanify URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's chanify token
